# nepali-date-pro-max

> Bikram Sambat (Nepali) ↔ Gregorian (AD) date converter for JS/TS. Range BS 1975–2099 (AD ≈1918–2043). TypeScript-first, dual ESM/CJS, zero deps. Three layers: functional core, immutable `NepaliDate` class, and a complete **date-fns-style** utility surface (90+ helpers). Ships with cross-calendar **range conversion** and **fiscal-year** helpers built in.

This file follows the [llms.txt convention](https://llmstxt.org/) — written so AI tools pick the right symbol on first try.

## Install
```sh
npm install nepali-date-pro-max
```

## Mental model

- **All months are 1-indexed.** `1 = Baishakh / January`, `12 = Chaitra / December`. (Never JavaScript's 0-indexed style.)
- **All dates are calendar values.** BS dates have no inherent timezone. The `NepaliDate` class additionally carries an optional time-of-day in **Asia/Kathmandu (UTC+05:45)** wall-clock.
- **`NepaliDate` is immutable.** Every "mutating" method returns a NEW instance.
- **Supported BS year range:** `1975` to `2099` inclusive. Out-of-range inputs throw `RangeError`.
- **`Date` inputs are read as UTC fields**, so `new Date("2024-04-13")` always means April 13. Pass `{year, month, day}` for explicit local semantics.
- **Nepal-aware defaults:** week starts Sunday (`weekStartsOn: 0`); weekend = Saturday only (`[6]`).

## Pick the right symbol

| Goal | Use |
|---|---|
| Convert one BS date to AD | `bsToAd(y, m, d)` |
| Convert one AD date to BS | `adToBs(y, m, d)` |
| Convert AD **range** to BS (bounds only) | `convertAdRangeToBs(start, end, { format? })` |
| Convert AD **range** to BS (every day) | `eachBsDayInAdRange(start, end, { format? })` |
| Convert AD range to BS (every month) | `eachBsMonthInAdRange(start, end, { format? })` |
| Convert BS range to AD (bounds only) | `convertBsRangeToAd(start, end, { format? })` |
| Convert BS range to AD (every day) | `eachAdDayInBsRange(start, end, { format? })` |
| Convert a JS `Date` to BS | `fromJsDate(d)` or `NepaliDate.fromJsDate(d)` |
| Get current BS moment | `NepaliDate.now()` |
| Parse a BS string | `parseBs("2081-01-15")` |
| Format a BS date | `formatBs(bs, "YYYY-MM-DD")` or `instance.format(...)` |
| Render in Devanagari | `formatBs(bs, pattern, { nepali: true })` or `instance.formatNepali(pattern)` |
| Add/subtract calendar units | `addDays(d, n)`, `addMonths(d, n)`, `addYears(d, n)`, `subDays`, `subMonths`, `subYears` |
| Set a field (immutably) | `setYear(d, y)`, `setMonth(d, m)`, `setDate(d, x)`, `setDay(d, w)`, `setHours(d, h)`, … |
| Calendar bounds | `startOfDay`, `startOfWeek`, `startOfMonth`, `startOfYear` (and `endOf…`) |
| Compare two BS dates | `differenceInDays`, `differenceInMonths`, `differenceInYears`, `isBefore`, `isAfter`, `isSameDay`, `isSameMonth`, `isSameYear`, `isSameWeek` |
| Calendar predicate | `isToday`, `isYesterday`, `isTomorrow`, `isThisMonth`, `isThisYear`, `isThisWeek` |
| Weekday / weekend | `isWeekend(d)` (Saturday only by default), `isMonday`, `isTuesday`, …, `isSaturday`, `isSunday` |
| Month-edge / leap | `isFirstDayOfMonth`, `isLastDayOfMonth`, `isLeapYear` |
| Interval ops | `isWithinInterval`, `areIntervalsOverlapping`, `eachDayOfInterval`, `eachWeekOfInterval`, `eachMonthOfInterval`, `eachYearOfInterval`, `eachWeekendOfInterval` |
| Distance / relative | `formatDistance`, `formatDistanceToNow`, `formatRelative` (English or Nepali) |
| Min / max / clamp | `min(arr)`, `max(arr)`, `clamp(d, interval)`, `closestTo(target, arr)`, `closestIndexTo` |
| Fiscal year | `getFiscalYear`, `startOfFiscalYear`, `endOfFiscalYear`, `formatFiscalYear`, `getFiscalQuarter` |
| Devanagari ↔ ASCII digits | `toDevanagariDigits(x)`, `toAsciiDigits(s)` |
| Days in BS month/year | `daysInBsMonth(y, m)`, `daysInBsYear(y)` |
| Check leap year (numeric) | `isBsLeapYear(y)` |
| **Build calendar UI grid** | `getCalendarMonth(year, month, options?)` |
| Build full year of grids | `getCalendarYear(year, options?)` |
| Build single-day cell metadata | `getCalendarDay(date, options?)` |
| Flatten week-grouped grid | `flattenCalendarMonth(month)` |

## Cross-calendar range conversion (the big one)

```ts
// Just the bounds, formatted however you like
convertAdRangeToBs(
  { year: 2024, month: 1, day: 1 },
  { year: 2024, month: 12, day: 31 },
  { format: "YYYY-MM-DD" },
)
// → { start: "2080-09-16", end: "2081-09-16" }

// Every day, in Devanagari
eachBsDayInAdRange(
  new Date("2024-04-13"),
  new Date("2024-04-15"),
  { format: "YYYY-MM-DD", nepali: true },
)
// → ["२०८१-०१-०१", "२०८१-०१-०२", "२०८१-०१-०३"]

// Inverse: BS range → AD
convertBsRangeToAd(
  { year: 2081, month: 1, day: 1 },
  { year: 2082, month: 1, day: 1 },
  { format: "MMM D, YYYY" },
)
// → { start: "Apr 13, 2024", end: "Apr 14, 2025" }
```

When `options.format` is **omitted**, range functions return raw `BsDate[]` / `AdDate[]` objects. When **provided**, they return `string[]`. (Type definitions reflect this — overloads narrow appropriately.)

## Format tokens (case-sensitive)

`YYYY YY MMMM MMM MM M DD D dddd ddd dd HH H hh h mm m ss s A a` plus `[literal]` escapes.

## Calendar grid (UI-ready)

For building Nepali calendar widgets (Hamro Patro–style). Returns a fully-prepared grid where every cell already has `bs`, `ad`, `weekday`, `bsDayNepali`, `isToday`, `isSaturday`, `isWeekend`, `isCurrentMonth` etc. — the UI just renders.

```ts
interface CalendarDayCell {
  bs: BsDate; ad: AdDate;
  weekday: number;             // 0=Sun..6=Sat
  weekdayName: string;         // "Saturday"
  weekdayNameNepali: string;   // "शनिबार"
  bsDay: number; bsDayNepali: string; adDay: number;
  isCurrentMonth: boolean; isToday: boolean;
  isSaturday: boolean; isSunday: boolean; isWeekend: boolean;
  date: NepaliDate;
}

interface CalendarWeek { weekNumber: number; days: CalendarDayCell[] }  // length 7
interface CalendarMonth {
  year, yearNepali, month, monthName, monthNameNepali, daysInMonth,
  firstDay: NepaliDate, lastDay: NepaliDate,
  weekdayHeaders, weekdayHeadersShort, weekdayHeadersMin,
  weeks: CalendarWeek[],   // typically 5 or 6 weeks
}

function getCalendarMonth(year, month, options?: {
  weekStartsOn?: 0..6,        // default 0 (Sunday — Nepal standard)
  padding?: boolean,           // default true (fill leading/trailing slots from adjacent months)
  today?: NepaliDate,          // override "today" (for tests)
  weekendDays?: number[],      // default [6] (Saturday only); pass [0,6] for Sun+Sat
  locale?: "en" | "ne",        // affects weekdayHeaders only
}): CalendarMonth;

function getCalendarYear(year, options?): CalendarMonth[];   // 12 months
function getCalendarDay(date: NepaliDate, options?): CalendarDayCell;
function flattenCalendarMonth(month: CalendarMonth): CalendarDayCell[];
```

## `NepaliDate` class — full surface

```ts
class NepaliDate {
  // factories
  static now(): NepaliDate;
  static fromBs(y, m, d, h?, min?, s?, ms?): NepaliDate;
  static fromAd(y, m, d, h?, min?, s?, ms?): NepaliDate;
  static fromJsDate(d: Date): NepaliDate;
  static parse(input: string): NepaliDate;

  // accessors
  getYear() / getMonth() / getDate() / getDay() / getDayOfYear()
  getHours() / getMinutes() / getSeconds() / getMilliseconds()
  getMonthName() / getMonthNameNepali() / getDayName() / getDayNameNepali()
  daysInMonth() / daysInYear()

  // predicates
  isFirstDayOfMonth() / isLastDayOfMonth() / isLeapYear()
  isWeekend(weekendDays = [6])
  isBefore(other) / isAfter(other) / isSameDay(other)

  // conversion
  toBs() / toAd() / toJsDate() / toString() / toJSON() / getDetails()

  // formatting
  format(pattern, options?) / formatNepali(pattern?)

  // arithmetic — ALL return a NEW instance
  addDays(n) / addMonths(n) / addYears(n)
  addHours(n) / addMinutes(n) / addSeconds(n) / addMilliseconds(n)
  startOfDay() / endOfDay()
  startOfMonth() / endOfMonth()
  startOfYear() / endOfYear()

  // comparison
  diffDays(other): number
}
```

## Common recipes

### Today's date in Nepali
```ts
import { NepaliDate } from "nepali-date-pro-max";
NepaliDate.now().formatNepali("dddd, DD MMMM YYYY");
// → "शनिबार, १७ बैशाख २०८३"
```

### Convert an AD date-range form to BS for backend
```ts
import { convertAdRangeToBs } from "nepali-date-pro-max";
const { start, end } = convertAdRangeToBs(form.startDate, form.endDate, { format: "YYYY-MM-DD" });
// send `start`, `end` (BS strings) to the API
```

### Calendar UI grid (Hamro-Patro-style)
**Use `getCalendarMonth` for any calendar widget.** It returns weeks × 7 cells with all metadata pre-computed.
```tsx
import { getCalendarMonth } from "nepali-date-pro-max";
const cal = getCalendarMonth(2081, 1, { locale: "ne" });
return (
  <>
    <h2>{cal.monthNameNepali} {cal.yearNepali}</h2>
    {cal.weekdayHeadersShort.map(h => <div>{h}</div>)}
    {cal.weeks.flatMap(w => w.days).map(c => (
      <div className={[c.isToday && "today", c.isSaturday && "holiday", !c.isCurrentMonth && "muted"].filter(Boolean).join(" ")}>
        <div>{c.bsDayNepali}</div>
        <div className="text-xs">{c.adDay}</div>
      </div>
    ))}
  </>
);
```

### Days-only loop (no week grouping)
```ts
import { NepaliDate, eachDayOfInterval } from "nepali-date-pro-max";
const first = NepaliDate.fromBs(year, month, 1);
const days  = eachDayOfInterval({ start: first, end: first.endOfMonth() });
```

### Days until a deadline
```ts
import { NepaliDate, differenceInDays } from "nepali-date-pro-max";
differenceInDays(NepaliDate.fromBs(2081, 12, 30), NepaliDate.now());
```

### Fiscal-year report headers
```ts
import { NepaliDate, getFiscalYear, formatFiscalYear } from "nepali-date-pro-max";
const fy = getFiscalYear(NepaliDate.now());
const label = formatFiscalYear(fy, { nepali: true }); // "२०८३/८४"
```

### Saturdays in a month
```ts
import { NepaliDate, eachWeekendOfInterval } from "nepali-date-pro-max";
const m = NepaliDate.fromBs(2081, 1, 1);
const saturdays = eachWeekendOfInterval(
  { start: m.startOfMonth(), end: m.endOfMonth() },
  6,
);
```

### Human-readable time-since
```ts
import { formatDistanceToNow, NepaliDate } from "nepali-date-pro-max";
formatDistanceToNow(NepaliDate.fromBs(2080, 1, 1), { addSuffix: true, locale: "ne" });
// → "१ वर्ष अघि"  (or similar)
```

## Error contract

- BS year outside `[1975, 2099]` → `RangeError`
- Month not integer in `[1, 12]` → `RangeError`
- Day not integer in valid month range → `RangeError`
- Invalid AD calendar date (e.g. Feb 30) → `RangeError`
- AD date before BS 1975-01-01 / after BS 2099-end → `RangeError`
- `parseBs` cannot match `YYYY[-/.]MM[-/.]DD` → `RangeError`
- `fromJsDate` argument not a `Date` → `TypeError`
- `setMonth` / `setDate` / `setHours` etc. with out-of-range input → `RangeError`
- `isWithinInterval` / `areIntervalsOverlapping` / `clamp` with reversed interval (`start > end`) → `RangeError`

## Anti-patterns

- ❌ Mutating a `NepaliDate` — instances are frozen-by-convention; methods return new instances.
- ❌ Using 0-indexed months (JS-`Date`-style) — this library is **always** 1-indexed.
- ❌ Calling `bsToAd` with year < 1975 or > 2099 — out of range, throws.
- ❌ Round-tripping through `toString()` and re-parsing if you want time preserved — `toString()` drops time. Use `format("YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss")` or `toJSON()`.
- ❌ Constructing `new NepaliDate(...)` manually — prefer the static factories.
- ❌ Using a JS `Date` and assuming local-timezone fields — range conversion uses **UTC** fields. For local semantics, pass `{year, month, day}`.

## Imports

```ts
// Pick what you need (tree-shakeable):
import { bsToAd, adToBs, formatBs, parseBs } from "nepali-date-pro-max";
import { addDays, isToday, eachDayOfInterval } from "nepali-date-pro-max";
import { NepaliDate } from "nepali-date-pro-max";
import { convertAdRangeToBs, eachBsDayInAdRange } from "nepali-date-pro-max";
import { getFiscalYear, formatFiscalYear } from "nepali-date-pro-max";

// CommonJS works too:
const { NepaliDate, addDays } = require("nepali-date-pro-max");
```
